name: Rocorona
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Extinct Chapacuran language attested only via a Pater Noster text (Teza 1868, per Glottolog)

sources.citation: Angenot-de Lima, Geralda. 1997. Fonotatica e fonologia do lexema Protochapakura. Dissertacao de Mestrado, UNIR (Guajara-Mirim). Sec. 3.13 'Fonemas e sons do Rokorona' pp.64-66; sec. 2.2 p.24.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 3.13 (source: CM&R 1913 spellings) gives a Rokorona phoneme/allophone inventory and phonotactics only, no stress. Sec. 2.2 p.24 states a family-wide rule ('Nas linguas Chapakura, a acentuacao dos lexemas e dedutivel do peso silabico.. /#(s)s#/ -> [(s)'s]', final heavy syllable stressed) but it rests on instrumental data from the living languages; p.7 says the dead languages never had their phonological systems described and her sketches are reinterpretations of old spellings.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page roco1235 (Hammarstrom et al.)
sources.note: Comment: extinct Chapacuran language of Bolivia attested only with the Pater Noster (Teza 1868); refs Teza 1868, Birchall 2013, Birchall et al. 2016. No descriptive (grammar/phonology) references.

sources.citation: Birchall, Joshua, Michael Dunn & Simon J. Greenhill. 2016. A combined comparative and phylogenetic analysis of the Chapacuran language family. IJAL 82(3): 255-284 (open postprint).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2 item 7 'Rokorona': 'The only source of language data on Rokorona is a collection of three prayers published in Teza (1868)'; excluded from the lexical analysis for lack of data; cites Birchall 2013.

sources.citation: de Crequi-Montfort, Georges & Paul Rivet. 1913. Linguistique bolivienne. La famille linguistique Capakura. Journal de la Societe des Americanistes 10: 119-171 (archive.org whole-volume scanned).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing for Rokorona. p.125 names the source (the Teza prayers, untranslated); pp.133-134 lexical concordances; pp.139-140 grammatical remarks (no gender distinction, plural maram-/maran-, koro-/kara- possessive, -na 3sg perfect, -sirit imperative, pa- locative). No accent statement.

sources.citation: Teza, Emilio. 1868. Saggi inediti di lingue americane: appunti bibliografici. Pisa: Nistri (estratto from Annali delle Universita Toscane, vol. X). 'Rocorona' = printed pp. 48-50.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. pp.48-50 print the Rocorona Pater Noster, Ave Maria and Credo (untranslated, from Hervas's manuscript papers) plus an ethnographic note (Hervas XVII,56; Mithridates III,577); no grammatical or phonetic commentary, texts printed essentially without accent marks (one grave, 'naùcami').

sources.citation: Birchall, Joshua. (2023/2024). Chapacuran. In Patience Epps & Lev Michael (eds.), Amazonian Languages: An International Handbook, vol. 1 (HSK 44.1). Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton.

sources.citation: Birchall, Joshua. 2013. A look at the Rokorona language. STUF - Language Typology and Universals (Sprachtypologie und Universalienforschung) 66(3): 257-271.
